---
title: Terminal with a light request
brand-mode: light
format:
  mcanouil-html: default
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: terminal
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A light request on the dark-only terminal preset warns once, and the tokens stay dark.
        warnings: exhaustive
        check: bash _checks/tokens.sh terminal-light
    mcanouil-html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'mcanouil: the terminal preset is dark only; brand-mode: light is ignored\.'
        count: 1
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'mcanouil: the terminal preset is dark only; brand-mode: light is ignored\.'
        count: 1
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['mode: "dark"']
---

A paragraph.
